what_it_does: KPIT Technologies sells specialized software development, systems integration, architecture, and engineering services to mobility and automotive companies including OEMs and suppliers, making money by delivering software-defined vehicle solutions, platforms, and products.

segments.name: Architecture, engineering activities, technical testing, and analysis activities

other_facts: Exports contributed 90% of total turnover in FY 2025-26.
The company operates offices across 17 international locations and 10 national locations.
Consolidated revenue from operations for FY 2025-26 was ₹64,549.31 million ($724.80 million).
